title: Launch Orbit Stability Slate and Initiative Dependency Graph
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: create a compact, reusable Launch Orbit Stability Slate (LOSS) and associated Initiative Dependency Graph (IDG) to standardize launch readiness signals across runtime, console and API teams. The LOSS is a timeboxed, prioritized checklist and signal dashboard that conveys: capacity hedges, rollback complexity, canary windows, and a computed Operational Exposure Index (OEI) for each initiative. The IDG is a curated dependency map that highlights blocking services, owner contacts, test coverage gaps, and cross-team escalation lanes.
proposal: Build a two-part deliverable: (1) a LOSS template with standard signals and thresholds that PM/Ops/Eng can adopt for any launch; (2) an IDG generator spreadsheet + visualization that pulls from project tags, runtime capacity reservations, and test-run coverage metrics. Operational Exposure Index = weighted sum of (capacity-scarcity, customer-surface-exposure, rollback-complexity, runbook-maturity). Use OEI buckets (green/yellow/red) to drive automatic gating recommendations in the launch calendar. Tie outputs to the launch calendar as metadata so release-train owners can filter by OEI and dependency depth.
acceptance_criteria: LOSS template created and published to Confluence with versioned examples for runtime, console, api launches
IDG generator spreadsheet created with documented input columns and an example auto-generated graph exported as PNG/SVG
OEI calculation documented with weights and default thresholds; example applied to two upcoming initiatives and results validated with engineering leads
Launch calendar integration: add OEI and top-3 dependency owners as metadata for each scheduled launch in the central launch calendar
Run a pilot: apply LOSS+IDG to next three sprints' release candidates; collect feedback and update template
Stakeholder sign-off: PM, Eng Managers (runtime/console/api), and Oncall lead have reviewed and approved gating recommendations
